title: Map editor shows a blank canvas: the loaded map's tiles are never drawn

path.to: Godot editor: standalone menu -> Editor -> click a map row (verified open in PAR-0067) -> editor shell, look at the MapView area

java: Launch the pinned Java client, open Editor -> maps, click a row (Open In Editor), observe the loaded map terrain, blocks and brush outline in the MapView canvas.
godot: Follow the PAR-0067 recipe (menu -> Editor -> click the Archipelago row) so MindEditor.status reports the loaded 500x500 map.

Observe: editor_view_mounted is false and the map area is the near-opaque dark Background ColorRect with no terrain; the SubViewport at MapView/ViewportContainer/SubViewport has an empty EditorWorldView Node2D child.
compare: Java draws editor.renderer.draw(...) inside the scissor rect (MapView.java:254). Godot has no editor draw pass and never calls MindRender.mount_editor_view, so the edited world is invisible.

plan.state: seeded by code-scan 2026-10-10; not yet verified in-engine
plan.seam: Editor rendering seam: client/scenes/editor/map_view.gd:99-135 only draws border/grid/brush, the map_view.tscn SubViewport holds an empty EditorWorldView (map_view.tscn:24-29), and client/rust/mind-gdext/src/render.rs:1300-1310 (mount_editor_view) merely stores a spec + hides the main bands; no render/*.rs pass draws the MindEditor grid.
plan.approach: 1) Add an editor draw pass in mind-gdext (new src/render/editor.rs or extend render.rs) that renders the MindEditor grid tiles (floors/walls/overlays, team colors) into the SubViewport's EditorWorldView node, driven by MapViewDriver zoom/offset and the grid epoch; reuse the existing TileGrid/atlas quad path until the plan-16 chunk meshes are shared into the viewport. 2) Call MindRender.mount_editor_view(spec) from map_view.gd when the editor dialog is shown and unmount_editor_view() on hide (currently zero callers). 3) Pass the SubViewport RID plus the current map_view_state()/camera rect in the spec. 4) Keep set_editor_view_active(true) hiding the main bands only after step 1 can actually draw, otherwise the editor is dark. 5) Keep the existing border/grid/brush _draw on top of the viewport.
plan.narrow_check: tools/build.sh && launch, open Editor -> map row, then `get_node("/root/Spine/MindRender").call("editor_view_mounted")` returns true and a screenshot of the MapView region shows terrain tiles of the loaded map (non-background pixels) instead of the flat dark ColorRect.

note: Code-scan 2026-10-10 (maps-editor): S2, confidence high. Player impact: the map editor is visually dead - a player opening any map (or a new map once creation is wired) sees a blank dark canvas and cannot see or verify any edit. PAR-0067 verified only that the editor opens with MindEditor.status; no ledger item covers the missing render. In-engine verification pending.

title: Leaving the map editor silently discards unsaved changes (no confirm)

path.to: Godot editor shell -> draw a block -> click Back (or Escape)

java: In the Java editor, draw anything, open the menu and press Quit: a @confirm/@editor.unsaved dialog appears; cancel keeps editing, confirm runs logic.reset() then hide().
godot: Open a map in the editor, draw a block, click Back (or press Escape).
Observe: the editor hides instantly and the editor_maps dialog opens; no confirm appears and the loaded world is left in place.
Code check: `try_exit` has zero GDScript callers and MindEditor.try_exit -> EditorPlayState::try_exit (playtest.rs:160-162) is a stub returning true without showing anything or resetting.
compare: Java MapEditorDialog.tryExit (789-795) always shows the confirm and runs logic.reset on accept; the Godot exit path bypasses both.

plan.state: seeded by code-scan 2026-10-10; not yet verified in-engine
plan.seam: Editor exit seam: client/scenes/editor/map_editor_dialog.gd:57-61 (_exit_to_maps) hides and returns to the map list directly; client/rust/mind-gdext/src/editor/mod.rs:1177-1180 delegates to mind-core's stub try_exit (client/rust/mind-core/src/editor/playtest.rs:157-162) which only returns true.
plan.approach: 1) Route Back/Escape through MindEditor.try_exit(); when it reports a confirm is required, show the @confirm/@editor.unsaved dialog via MindUi and on accept call a new MindEditor.exit_confirmed() that hides the editor, performs the port's logic.reset() equivalent (clear the editor grid/world + op stack, reset rules/session state) and opens editor_maps; on cancel keep editing. 2) Give EditorPlayState::try_exit a real outcome (e.g. a TryExit result enum / callback) or move the confirm ownership entirely into the gdext facade while the core only owns the reset hook. 3) Make sure the same path covers the (currently absent) menu quit button and the playtest/back transitions (playtest.rs:88-155).
plan.narrow_check: Draw a block, click Back: a confirm dialog node is visible; Cancel returns to the editor with the block still there; Confirm returns to editor_maps and MindEditor.status exposes an empty/reset grid. In-engine MCP: screenshot the confirm before accepting.

note: Code-scan 2026-10-10 (maps-editor): S2, confidence high (data loss). Player impact: closing the editor throws away unsaved drawing/metadata work with no warning, while upstream always confirms and resets the world only on accept. Compounded by the missing save UI (see the sibling editor-menu item). In-engine verification pending.

title: Planet-generated campaign sectors have no core and no enemy base: launch loadout, ruins and base walls are skipped

path.to: Godot: launch a non-preset sector (planet-page hex with no preset, or MindSimHost.load_sector('serpulo', <id>) for a cell whose preset is None) and inspect the world; Java: same sector via World.loadSector

java: Launch the Java client on a sector without a stored map (planet generator path). Observe: a player core with the launch loadout at the spawn, derelict ruins scattered around ore, and (for enemy-base sectors) enemy core loadouts with walls and cleared unit paths.
godot: Start a campaign sector whose planet cell has no preset (MindSimHost.load_sector falls from load_preset_map_grid to mind_core::maps::planet::generate_sector, sim_host.rs:956-975).
Count core blocks / enemy blocks: zero cores and no base structures; also check MindSimHost's sector rules report player_cores == 0 so the campaign records no capture (campaign.rs:583-590).
Editor route: Editor -> Sector Generate Apply additionally returns false ('awaits the plan-06 load_sector host'), so the generated preview is not even reachable there.
compare: Java SerpuloPlanetGenerator.java:719 places the default-team launch loadout (core + launch resources), :726 calls basegen.generate for enemy bases/ruins, :745-752 runs basegen.postGenerate (power node configs, battery charge); the port explicitly skips all three (serpulo.rs:1313-1342) and generate_sector never calls post_generate (planet/mod.rs:65-76).

title: Map previews never render: custom game and editor map lists show a placeholder instead of the map image

path.to: Standalone menu -> Play -> Custom Game (map preview panel) and Editor -> maps list

java: Java client: Custom Game / Editor maps show each map's generated preview texture (MapListDialog.java:213, Map.safeTexture with the error.png fallback); previews are generated on first client load by Maps.createAllPreviews.
godot: Menu -> Play -> Custom Game: the selected map panel is a placeholder glyph (custom_game_dialog.gd:223-237) with a 'preview placeholder' comment; Editor -> maps rows are name-only buttons.

Run `get_node("/root/Spine/MindPreview").call("texture_for", <map path>)`: no UI ever calls it, and MindPreview.refresh() only reloads the registry (preview.rs:126-128) without running PreviewPipeline.load_previews/create_all_previews, so no preview PNG/cache is ever generated.
Save a map in the editor: MindEditor.save uses save_editor_map (no PreviewPipeline; editor/mod.rs:1011-1058) unlike maps_glue::save_map_e2e, so the saved map still has no preview.
compare: Java generates+displays previews; Godot never generates them and never binds texture_for, so every map list shows a placeholder even when a cached PNG exists.

plan.state: seeded by code-scan 2026-10-10; not yet verified in-engine
plan.seam: Preview pipeline seam: MindPreview.refresh (client/rust/mind-gdext/src/editor/preview.rs:126-128) never calls PreviewPipeline::{load_previews,create_all_previews,check_previews} (client/rust/mind-core/src/editor/preview.rs:48,73,128, zero live callers); MindEditor.save (gdext editor/mod.rs:1011-1058) uses save_editor_map (maps_glue.rs:105-125) instead of save_map_e2e (maps_glue.rs:178-215); textures are never bound into the map-list UI.
plan.approach: 1) Run PreviewPipeline.load_previews + create_all_previews from MindPreview.refresh() (client path equivalent of Maps.createAllPreviews, Maps.java:113/385-420) so each registered map gets a preview PNG + cache on boot; keep it off the sim tick. 2) Route MindEditor.save/export_map through maps_glue::save_map_e2e so a saved editor map generates its preview immediately. 3) Bind MindPreview.texture_for(row.path) into the map-list rows (custom_game_dialog preview panel and editor_maps_dialog rows) with the error.png fallback when None (Map.safeTexture, Map.java:70-71; upstream error sprite res://assets sprites/error equivalent). 4) Assert maps_list().preview becomes true after refresh for a built-in map.
plan.narrow_check: Boot -> Play -> Custom Game: the selected map panel shows a real image (pixel variance, not the glyph) and `MindPreview.texture_for(path)` returns a Texture2D for a built-in map after refresh(); save an editor map and confirm a preview PNG appears under the previews dir and the row renders it.

note: Code-scan 2026-10-10 (maps-editor): S3, confidence medium (UI placeholder observed in code; texture_for is implemented but unbound, and no live preview generation exists). Player impact: map selection in Custom Game and the Editor maps list lacks the map image Java shows; PAR-0065 verified the rows but not previews. Plan 19's deferred 'Gd<ImageTexture> binding' is half-landed: the binding exists (preview.rs:193) but nothing calls it and nothing generates pixels. In-engine verification pending.
